The '''Second Colonial Protectorate''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] colony built in the [[Brell Sediment]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Second Colonial Protectorate appears in the Imperial version of the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It takes the place of the [[Junction (purification facility)|Junction]], a class-restricted area for the [[Jedi Consular]] in the Republic version of Taris, and the Junction is moved to the [[Tularan Marsh]].
